lines: I should get back to reading the water before the weather turns.
Best I return to my net and line before the evening tide shifts.
The current has been tugging strange today. I ought to check it.
There is a knot in one of my lines that will only get worse if I ignore it.
I need to ready the bait bucket before dawn sneaks up on me.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the traps and boatside knots.
The river keeps its secrets unless you give it your full attention.
I promised myself I would patch that ripped net before the week is out.
It is getting late. I should head back to the shore.
I will be out there again when the moon sits higher.
